rv.q: Little Shop is a great Halloween, creepy musical.

Before catching “Little Shop of Horrors” at Music Theater Works over the weekend, it had been at least five years since I’d seen the campy sci-fi musical from 1982 about a bloodthirsty plant from outer space. Despite the fine efforts of director Kyle A.
LITTLE SHOP OF HORRORS is a fun visit to Skid Row! The play is especially a treat for families around Halloween. In this production, the music and the comedy are particularly alluring.
It's been a minute since Chicago enjoyed such a superbly performed production of Alan Menken and Howard Ashman's clever, captivating musical satire.
I have seen several stage versions of this musical, but the current one at the Music Theater Works is one of my favorites.
I can tell you that this show will give you two hours and ten minutes ( with one intermission) of delight!
